name: Delwart
about: Delwart is the mysterious contact who tracks Gladias down and meets him in private booths in Meldan. He is only ever seen in a privacy robe or with its hood down, and the book never describes his face, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: another man wearing a privacy robe stepped in
facts.fact: A man; arrives in a privacy robe.

facts.quote: Both took off the face covers and hoods from their privacy robes.
facts.fact: Shows his face in private booths.

facts.quote: his own tea, and some kind of rectangular nutrition bar
facts.fact: Orders tea and a nutrition bar.

facts.quote: He always wears a new privacy robe every day, he re-randomizes his insoles to change his gait and his height
facts.fact: New robe daily; height and gait disguised.

facts.quote: He looks around much less than the average person, he feels really focused on where he's going.
facts.fact: Walks with fixed, focused attention and does not turn his head.

facts.quote: with a sorry expression on his face
facts.fact: Can put on a contrite expression.

facts.quote: that he was just a kindly man who cared about peace and freedom
facts.fact: Presents himself as a kindly man.

descriptor: a man of indeterminate middle age, of average height and lean, pale skin, a long calm face with neatly combed straight grey hair parted at the side, clean-shaven, a fixed forward gaze, wearing a plain beige knit polo shirt, pressed grey slacks and plain grey shoes
sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain warm off-white background: three full-body views of the same person side by side, front view facing the viewer, three-quarter view, and back view, neutral standing pose, even lighting.
